Key notes from discovery (15 Mar):
- Stakeholders: Alex Moreno (CTO) + procurement (TBD).
- Use case: LLM-driven triage for clinical notes ingestion; main ask is low-latency embeddings + private deployment options.
- Success criteria: POC that demonstrates throughput at 1.5k reqs/min and data residency controls.
- Open blockers: KMS integration (they require HSM-backed keys), SOC2 audit timeline, and an internal security review.

What I tried so far: sent a post-call recap on 3/9 with proposed next steps (POC + tech session). No reply. I propose a measured recontact rather than a hard push.

Asks from me:
1) Ben — can you review the attached handoff checklist and add any SE-side constraints we should call out (KMS/HSM, certs, sample data requirements)?
2) Marissa — can you take point on a short re-engagement bump (email draft attached) and schedule if I don't hear back by Friday?
3) Priyom / Aditya — would appreciate a quick read on whether we offer a small onboarding credit for POC (helps get exec attention).

Attachments: novacare-bump-draft.txt, novacare-handoff-checklist.pdf (see drive link below).
